scope: Read complete Japanese premises/exchanges and all12 target sentence/task sets. Metadata/native/device approval excluded.
reviewCriteria: Separate unrelated family papers; retain both received messages and the learner's replies in chronological context.
Displayed layered clothes are sold separately; garment beneath jacket is not automatically underwear; distinguish fit with the front fastened and a larger size.
Head removal does not remove all fish bones; limit shop preparation and preserve uncertainty and rechecking before cooking.
Large-print material is not guaranteed; request reading aloud, pause at same-household terminology, and defer interpretation to responsible staff.
